rules.loss: Stand-in: lot measurements left out; dimensions converted from mm to m.
Stand-in: total share and its basis shown; the split and the evidence are not.
Stand-in: method, unit and boundary shown; evidence left out. Not a declaration of conformity.
Stand-in: only the approved text in the requested language.
Stand-in: the measured value, its uncertainty and the evidence are withheld; only the screening result is shown.

preconditions: stand-in: every input the route needs is present, allowed and accepted
stand-in: footprint method and unit match
failure: Stand-in: the recipient sees HOLD with a generic message; the detailed reasons stay internal.
